source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a US analysis of 19 million pregnancy-related admissions (1,553 associated with NF1), NF1 was associated with a statistically significant excess of maternal morbidity (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, intrauterine growth restriction, cerebrovascular disease, preterm labor, cesarean delivery) but not maternal mortality.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 57 Terry 2013 (PMID not resolved). Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 57
